why: Issue #289's own report: 'Transitions between menus seem to not work? Or at least I haven't seen them in action?'. With the OS asking for reduced motion, a menu that never animates and a control reading only 'Match device' leave nothing on screen connecting the two -- which is the state that made the missing control hard to even diagnose. 'Full' and 'Reduced' name their own answers; 'Match device' is the one state that cannot, so it is the one that reports the resolved policy.
killedBy: hud: the motion toggle (issue #289) reports the RESOLVED policy on Match device, which is the state its own name cannot say
